topography.project_purpose: Yield Aggregator. Structurally: 26 project-authored contract(s) across 4 chain(s); 1 ERC20 token; upgradeable via ERC1967/UUPS proxies; built on openzeppelin.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 7 functional families. Its contracts share 6 common project-authored base contract(s) (proxy, access, bridge). Dominant framework: openzeppelin.
